NexusHunterCarnageMaximumEffort.name: Maximum Effort
NexusHunterCarnageMaximumEffort.description: If Carnage damages the same enemy Hero 3 times it deals an additional 108 (+4% per level) damage and Slows by 25% for 2.5 seconds.

NexusHunterFatalWounds.name: Fatal Wounds
NexusHunterFatalWounds.description: While at maximum stacks, Blood Rage's bleed deals 30% additional damage to enemy Heroes under 50% Health. Quest: Damage enemy Heroes with Blood Rage's bleed damage. Reward: After damaging Heroes with Blood Rage's bleed damage 150 times, Blood Rage's duration is increased by 2 sec

NexusHunterFinishingTouch.name: Finishing Touch
NexusHunterFinishingTouch.description: Gain 20% Basic Attack damage. When Qhira Basic Attacks an enemy Hero below 50% Health it deals 20% additional damage, and she gains 35% Attack Speed for 3 seconds.

NexusHunterUpstage.name: Upstage
NexusHunterUpstage.description: Damaging at least 2 Heroes with Blood Rage causes Qhira to Evade the next 4 Heroic Basic Attacks within 12 seconds.

NexusHunterEnsnaringSwing.name: Ensnaring Swing
NexusHunterEnsnaringSwing.description: The primary target of Revolving Sweep is Slowed by 60% while Qhira is attached to them. Secondary targets hit by Revolving Sweep's swing are Slowed by 40% for 3 seconds.

NexusHunterBloodRageYourPainMyGain.name: Your Pain, My Gain
NexusHunterBloodRageYourPainMyGain.description: Basic Attacking an enemy Hero causes Qhira to gain 10 Armor for 3 seconds. Stacks 3 times.

NexusHunterTheThirst.name: The Thirst
NexusHunterTheThirst.description: Carnage heals for 50% of the damage dealt to enemy Heroes. Anytime Carnage damages an enemy Hero, Qhira's next Basic Attack within 4 seconds against an enemy Hero deals 15% additional damage, stacking up to 10 times.

NexusHunterBloodRageHealmonger.name: Healmonger
NexusHunterBloodRageHealmonger.description: If Blood Rage damages an enemy Hero below 50% Health, it heals for an additional 190 (+4% per level) Health.

NexusHunterSiphoningLink.name: Siphoning Link
NexusHunterSiphoningLink.description: Damaging an enemy Hero with Revolving Sweep's initial impact or swing causes Qhira to regenerate 96 (+4% per level) Health over 4 seconds. Stacks up to 4 times. Passive: Basic Attacks heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

NexusHunterUnrelentingStrikes.name: Unrelenting Strikes
NexusHunterUnrelentingStrikes.description: Deal 44 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies every 0.5 seconds for 2.5 seconds as your sword grows outward. Upon expiring, deal 160 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemy Heroes and Stun them for 1.5 seconds.

NexusHunterFinalStrike.name: Final Strike
NexusHunterFinalStrike.description: After 1 second, deal 395 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in a line. This damage is increased by 25% against enemy Heroes who are below 50% Health.

NexusHunterChainsaw.name: Chainsaw
NexusHunterChainsaw.description: Carnage's cooldown recharges 100% faster while an enemy Hero has maximum Blood Rage stacks.

NexusHunterPulsingPain.name: Pulsing Pain
NexusHunterPulsingPain.description: Each additional enemy Hero hit by Revolving Sweep causes the primary target to take an additional 135 (+4% per level) damage.

NexusHunterTheHunted.name: The Hunted
NexusHunterTheHunted.description: Basic Attacking an enemy Hero increases your Basic Attack damage against that Hero by 25%. Stacks up to 4 times and lasts 4 seconds. Bonus is reset if a different Hero is attacked.

NexusHunterRevolvingSweepBoomingKick.name: Booming Kick
NexusHunterRevolvingSweepBoomingKick.description: Increase the Stun duration of Revolving Sweep's re-activation by 0.25 seconds. Enemy Heroes around the primary target are also affected by Revolving Sweep's re-activation.

NexusHunterRevolvingSweepLingeringAilmen.name: Lingering Ailment
NexusHunterRevolvingSweepLingeringAilmen.description: Enemy Heroes hit by Revolving Sweep or by Grappling Hook have their Armor reduced by 25 for 3 seconds.

NexusHunterRevolvingSweepSwingLifeAway.name: Swing Life Away
NexusHunterRevolvingSweepSwingLifeAway.description: Revolving Sweep's cooldown recharges 250% faster while Qhira is swinging around her target. She also gains 60 Spell Armor for 5 seconds after the re-activation impact.

NexusHunterUnrelentingStrikesSilentKille.name: Silent Killer
NexusHunterUnrelentingStrikesSilentKille.description: Hitting enemy Heroes with Unrelenting Strikes Silences them for 0.5 seconds and reduces its cooldown by 3 seconds.

NexusHunterFinalStrikeUnleashedPotential.name: Unleashed Potential
NexusHunterFinalStrikeUnleashedPotential.description: Increase the damage to enemy Heroes under 50% Health from 25% to 50%. If an enemy Hero dies within 1.5 seconds of being hit by Final Strike, then reset the cooldowns of Final Strike and all of Qhira's Basic Abilities.

NexusHunterGrapplingHookUtilityBelt.name: Utility Belt
NexusHunterGrapplingHookUtilityBelt.description: Grappling Hook's cooldown is reset when hitting an enemy Hero with the initial impact of Revolving Sweep and recharges 900% faster if Qhira hasn't taken damage within the last 2 seconds.

NexusHunterHuntersVengeanceNoSanctuary.name: No Sanctuary
NexusHunterHuntersVengeanceNoSanctuary.description: Nearby enemy Heroes below 50% Health are revealed and you gain 20% Movement Speed while an enemy Hero is revealed by you in this way. Additionally, you deal 20% increased damage to these revealed enemies.
